text: Water rising fast in attic! 2 adults and 1 toddler trapped. Mother needs insulin urgently!!
roof caved in water up to our chests 3 people here hypothermia setting in cant swim help us please
ON THE ROOF WITH 2 BABIES AND MY WIFE. FLOOD WATER CURRENT IS STRONG. PLEASE SEND A BOAT
stuck on second floor water reached 1st floor ceiling. Just me here, power out, oxygen concentrator battery dying fast 15% left
Concrete slab fell on my husband legs pinned and bleeding heavily from deep cut. 2 adults trapped in basement.
Stairwell collapsed, 4 of us on 3rd floor cannot get down, smoke coming up. One pregnant woman having contractions.
Building fell down. Cant breath dust everywhere. Me and my 8yr old son under table. Help us!!
Flames surrounding driveway, car won't start. 2 people, severe 3rd degree burns on hands and face.
Heavy black smoke filling apartment, coughing blood. Elderly grandmother unable to walk without wheelchair.
Roof sustained minor leak. My father slipped and dislocated shoulder, cannot move arm. We have food and dry shelter for 3 people.
Road is washed out by river. We are 5 adults stranded at camp cabin. Stable, but out of prescription cardiac medication since yesterday.
Tree fell across front porch blocking door. We can climb out back window if needed. 1 broken wrist on teenager, 2 adults. Safe from storm for now.
Car broke down in blizzard off highway 80. Engine running low on fuel. 2 adults and infant. Warm clothes but need towing before dark.
Power is out for 24 hours. We are 4 adults safe in house with non-perishable food. Just need drinking water delivery when available.
Minor scratches from broken glass, bandaged already. 2 people safe in community center basement. No immediate danger.
Water in yard but house dry. Family of 3 with baby, we have 4 days food. Inquiring about evacuation shelter status.
One body found under collapsed masonry, no pulse for over 2 hours, unresponsive. Survivor 1 adult uninjured nearby.
Water is outside the door but we are NOT trapped and NOT injured. 3 adults and 2 golden retrievers safe inside.
There are zero injuries here. Power line sparking on street outside. 1 person alone inside looking out window.
me, my husband, our two young daughters and my elderly grandmother trapped in attic. grandmother has heart failure and chest pain.
Severe gas leak smell throughout hallway! Sparks from fusebox. 6 people unable to exit due to jammed fire door. Hurry!
Active shooter reported down street, barricaded in classroom with 14 students and 1 teacher. Nobody wounded yet.
Flash flood carried truck into ditch. Water up to dashboard and rising. 2 adults 1 baby trapped inside cab!
Tornado hit neighborhood. Our roof collapsed into hallway, 1 adult pinned under ceiling joist with broken pelvis and severe arterial bleeding.
Wildfire jumped ridge line, house caught fire! 3 of us trapped in swimming pool with wet towels, extreme smoke inhalation cannot breath.
72-year-old grandfather in severe diabetic ketoacidosis, unconscious, insulin was destroyed in flood. 2 adults here.
Chainsaw accident while clearing storm debris, deep laceration to thigh, spurting blood, tourniquet applied. 1 victim.
Furnace failed in -20F blizzard. 2 adults and 3 children under blankets, 1 baby showing signs of severe hypothermia lips turning blue.
Train derailment nearby, strong chlorine gas smell burning eyes and throat, 4 people vomiting and gasping for air.
High voltage power line fell onto our occupied SUV in rain. 2 adults inside. Tires smoking, afraid to step out.
Mudslide swept through living room. My sister is buried to her waist in mud and debris, unable to extract her. 2 people total.
Basement flooded with 2 feet of water. Furnaces off. 3 adults stranded on main floor. Cold but dry, need evacuation assist tomorrow.
Earthquake cracked our walls, door is stuck shut but structure seems stable. 2 adults, 1 has sprained ankle. Food supplies good.
Bridge washed out behind our subdivision. 8 adults cut off from main road. Everyone uninjured, seeking supplies.
Grandmother's oxygen machine backup battery has 6 hours remaining. She is resting comfortably now with 2 adults watching her.
Chimney collapsed into yard. 4 adults, one cuts on arm cleaned and dressed. Road impassable due to fallen oak tree.
Boat engine died in floodwaters, drifting in slow eddy near trees. 3 adults wearing life vests, no immediate tipping danger.
Cell service down. 2 adults and 2 kids at home, completely safe, house intact, checking when grid power will be restored.
Water main broke down street, no tap water. 1 person alone in apartment. Plenty of canned food, just requesting drinking water.
Hail broke skylight, water on rug. Cleaned up, plastic tarp placed. 2 adults doing fine.
Checking in for our block. 6 neighbors sheltering in church hall. Plenty of blankets and warm soup, no injuries whatsoever.
Minor burn on finger from cooking candle, ointment applied. 1 adult. Safe in garage.
Elderly neighbor passed away overnight from hypothermia, cold and stiff, no breathing or pulse. 1 survivor adult here.
Found car submerged in canal, driver trapped underwater for 30 minutes, unrecoverable, dead. Calling from bank 1 person.
Do not send ambulance, no one is hurt. Fire is 3 blocks away, not threatening our house. 5 adults here safe.
We are NOT out of food or water, no bleeding, no injuries. Tree fell in back yard. 2 adults.
Overturned tour bus on highway overpass with 25 adults and children injured, multiple people trapped in wreckage.
MY MOM CANNOT BREATH. ASH EVERYWHERE. WE ARE 3 ADULTS TRAPPED IN BASEMENT DOOR JAMMED.
Just 1 elderly person here, power is out. I have my insulin in a cooler with ice, so I am good for 48 hours. No assistance needed yet.
Tsunami warning sounded, ocean receded. 4 people running up hill toward high ground, completely exposed, no injuries yet.
My mom just called me and I heard her fall. She lives at 123 Applyberry Lane and has had previous medicial issues. PLEASE HURRY!
I live a few blocks away from a Walmart. I heard the building collapsed and people are screaming. Send help.
Reporting on behalf of my elderly father at 450 Elm Street. His oxygen concentrator shut off with the storm outage, he is gasping for air!
Can see smoke rising from North High School down the street. Roof partially caved in. People running outside.
